Dear Sir/Madam, 
 
Sub: Audio and Video recording of Investor Day of Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles 
Limited (formerly Tata Motors Limited) (‘the Company’) 
 
Pursuant to Regulation 30 of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) 
Regulations, 2015 and further to our letter bearing sc no. 18881 dated March 23, 2026, we wish to 
inform you that the audio and video recording of the Investor Day held on June 23, 2026 has been 
made available on the Company’s website. 
 
The link to access the said recording is https://youtu.be/Zvm2z4CwqAo?si=d4uaqcLcQmlYtZ0c 
 
  
This is for information of the Exchanges and the Members. 
 
 
Yours faithfully 
Tata Motors Passenger Vehicles Limited 
(formerly Tata Motors Limited) 
 
  
 
Maloy Kumar Gupta
